description: Candidate analytical and published-reference targets for experimental diagnostics; source artifacts and independent review are pending.

NAFEMS_LE1.title: NAFEMS LE1 Elliptic Membrane Outward Pressure
NAFEMS_LE1.source: NAFEMS Standard Benchmarks (1990), Test LE1 — Plane Stress Elliptic Membrane

NAFEMS_LE10.title: NAFEMS LE10 Thick Plate Pressure (3D HEX20 Continuum)
NAFEMS_LE10.source: NAFEMS Standard Benchmarks (1990), Test LE10 — Thick Elliptic Plate Under Normal Pressure

NAFEMS_LE11.title: NAFEMS LE11 Solid Cylinder/Taper/Sphere Temperature Gradient
NAFEMS_LE11.source: NAFEMS Standard Benchmarks (1990), Test LE11 — Thermoelastic Solid Cylinder/Taper/Sphere

NAFEMS_FV32.title: NAFEMS FV32 Cantilevered Tapered Membrane Fundamental Frequency
NAFEMS_FV32.source: NAFEMS Free Vibration Benchmarks (1990), Test FV32 — In-Plane Vibration of Cantilevered Tapered Membrane

NAFEMS_T1.title: NAFEMS T1 2D Membrane Heat Conduction
NAFEMS_T1.source: NAFEMS Thermal Benchmarks (1989), Test T1 — 2D Steady/Transient Heat Transfer

NASA_TMR_FLAT_PLATE.title: NASA Langley TMR 2D Zero-Pressure-Gradient Turbulent Flat Plate (Re_L = 5e6)
NASA_TMR_FLAT_PLATE.source: NASA Langley Turbulence Modeling Resource (CFL3D/FUN3D & Karman-Schoenherr ZPG Flat Plate, M=0.2, Re_L=5e6)

NASA_TMR_CORRELATION_DIAGNOSTIC.title: Analytic NASA TMR correlation integration diagnostic (no flow solver comparison)
NASA_TMR_CORRELATION_DIAGNOSTIC.source: Bundled NASA TMR Karman-Schoenherr table; this diagnostic integrates the momentum correlation and does not run CFD

HERTZ_AXISYMMETRIC_CONTACT_DIAGNOSTIC.title: Axisymmetric Hertz-contact discretization diagnostic (not a 3D contact FEA case)
HERTZ_AXISYMMETRIC_CONTACT_DIAGNOSTIC.source: Hertz (1882) closed-form equations are used for comparison; no external contact measurement data is bundled

SPARSE_SPD_GENERATED_SUITE.title: Generated sparse SPD and Poisson manufactured diagnostics (not the NIST archive)
SPARSE_SPD_GENERATED_SUITE.source: Generated SPD systems and a Poisson manufactured solution; no original NIST sparse matrix archive is used

CANTILEVER_BEAM_ANALYTIC_DIAGNOSTIC.title: Synthetic Timoshenko cantilever static/modal/PSD diagnostic (not Hannover data)
CANTILEVER_BEAM_ANALYTIC_DIAGNOSTIC.source: Timoshenko beam formulation and analytic input assumptions; no Hannover measurement file or calibration is used

OPTICAL_PSF_PARAXIAL_DIAGNOSTIC.title: Analytic optical PSF/MTF and synthetic paraxial tolerance helper diagnostic (not ISO 10110 qualification)
OPTICAL_PSF_PARAXIAL_DIAGNOSTIC.source: Analytic Airy-diffraction and paraxial formulas; no ISO 10110 tolerance catalog or conformance data is used

HERTZ_CONTACT_3D.title: Named 3D sphere-on-flat contact reference candidate (unavailable)
HERTZ_CONTACT_3D.source: Johnson, K. L. (1985), Contact Mechanics, Cambridge University Press, Chapter 4; no external result artifact is bundled
HERTZ_CONTACT_3D.reason: The current product route returns a closed-form estimate; the separate axisymmetric discretization diagnostic is not a 3D contact FEA solve.

NIST_SPARSE_ROBUSTNESS.title: NIST sparse archive reference candidate (unavailable)
NIST_SPARSE_ROBUSTNESS.source: The exact NIST archive/source version has not been identified or bundled; Roache and Davis are numerical-method references, not archive provenance
NIST_SPARSE_ROBUSTNESS.reason: No original NIST matrix data is bundled. SPARSE_SPD_GENERATED_SUITE is a separate generated diagnostic and is not a NIST run.

HANOVER_BEAM_DYNAMIC_RESPONSE.title: Hannover laboratory beam response reference candidate (unavailable)
HANOVER_BEAM_DYNAMIC_RESPONSE.source: Dataset DOI 10.25835/lyav246d; external measurements are recorded in validation_readiness.js but are not loaded or used by this candidate spec
HANOVER_BEAM_DYNAMIC_RESPONSE.reason: The cantilever analytic diagnostic is a separate test and does not use Hannover measurement data.

ISO_10110_OPTICS_TOLERANCE.title: ISO 10110 tolerance reference candidate (unavailable)
ISO_10110_OPTICS_TOLERANCE.source: ISO 10110-5 is referenced as a candidate standard; standard text, tolerance data, catalog rights, and applicability are not reviewed
ISO_10110_OPTICS_TOLERANCE.reason: OPTICAL_PSF_PARAXIAL_DIAGNOSTIC and PLATE_THICKNESS_OPD_ANALYTIC are formula diagnostics, not ISO 10110 conformance cases.
